description: Official raw transaction schema for Einkaufpark DE. All 50 stores must produce CSV exports conforming to this contract. One row per line item purchased.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the transaction. Format: TXN-{store_id}-{12-char hex}. 0.4% of rows may be duplicates due to POS retry behaviour — handled by dedup in silver layer.

columns.name: basket_id
columns.description: Groups all line items belonging to one customer visit. Derived as MD5(transaction_id + store_id + order_date). All rows for the same visit share the same basket_id.

columns.name: batch_id
columns.description: Identifies the data generation or export run that produced this file. Derived from MD5 of config parameters — identical across re-runs with the same seed, enabling reproducibility.

columns.name: source_system
columns.description: The POS system that produced this record. SAP_POS covers 85% of stores; LEGACY_POS_CSV covers 15% of older small-town branches.

columns.name: record_hash
columns.description: MD5 hash of (transaction_id + order_date + customer_id + product_id + store_id). Used as the deduplication key in the silver layer. Two rows with the same record_hash are considered identical.

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Calendar date on which the transaction occurred. Seasonality-biased in the generator: Friday/Saturday peak, December peak, Black Friday week (ISO 47), pre-Easter (ISO 13–15), December 1–23.

columns.name: ship_date
columns.description: For in-store transactions this always equals order_date. Approximately 0.3% of rows have a ±1-day difference due to POS timezone misalignment — these receive WARN:DATE_SEQUENCE_ERROR.

columns.name: ingestion_date
columns.description: Wall-clock date when the CSV file was generated or exported. Used to track data latency.

columns.name: sales_channel
columns.description: Channel through which the sale occurred. Always IN_STORE for this dataset — no e-commerce or click-and-collect.

columns.name: order_status
columns.description: Final status of the transaction. Distribution: Completed 93%, Voided 3%, Partially_Returned 2.5%, Returned 1.5%.

columns.name: store_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the physical store. Format: EKP-DE-{3-digit number}. Range: EKP-DE-001 to EKP-DE-050.

columns.name: store_city
columns.description: German city where the store is located.

columns.name: store_district
columns.description: Neighbourhood or Stadtteil within the city.

columns.name: store_postal_code
columns.description: 5-digit German postal code (PLZ).

columns.name: store_area
columns.description: Street name where the store is located.

columns.name: store_region
columns.description: German federal state (Bundesland) the store belongs to.

columns.name: store_country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Always DE for this dataset.

columns.name: store_country_name
columns.description: Full country name. Always Germany for this dataset.

columns.name: store_size_class
columns.description: Store size classification. L=large city hypermarket (21 stores), M=mid-city store (11 stores), S=small-town store (18 stores). Affects terminal count and average basket size.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Identifier for the customer. Format: CUST{1–300000}. Guest/anonymous transactions use GUEST-{uuid} or null. The same customer_id always maps to the same age, gender, and loyalty tier.

columns.name: customer_age
columns.description: Customer age in years. Nullable for guest transactions. Known DQ issues: ~0.3% have impossible values (121–160) flagged as WARN:AGE_INVALID; ~0.15% are negative due to legacy migration artifacts.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Customer gender. Nullable for guests. Known encoding inconsistency across source systems: values can be M, Male, F, Female, Divers, or null. Normalised to M/F/Divers/null in the silver layer.

columns.name: membership_active
columns.description: True if the customer scanned a loyalty card for this transaction. Approximately 54% penetration among post-March-2023 transactions. False for all guest transactions.

columns.name: loyalty_card_id
columns.description: Loyalty card number. Format: KLC{8-digit number}. Null when membership_active is false. Loyalty programme launched 2023-03-01.

columns.name: loyalty_tier
columns.description: Customer loyalty tier. Distribution among members: Bronze 55%, Silver 28%, Gold 12%, Platinum 5%. Null for non-members.

columns.name: loyalty_points_earned
columns.description: Points earned on this transaction. Multiplier by tier: Bronze 1x, Silver 1.5x, Gold 2x, Platinum 3x net_revenue_eur. Zero on voided or returned transactions. Null for non-members.

columns.name: coupon_applied
columns.description: True if a loyalty coupon was redeemed on this transaction. Approximately 15% of member transactions use a coupon. Always false for non-members.

columns.name: coupon_code
columns.description: Coupon code redeemed. Format: KL-{SAVE5|SAVE10|BIO15|WEEK20|VIP30}-{4-digit}. Null when coupon_applied is false.

columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Identifier for the product scanned. Derived as PROD + first 6 chars of MD5(product_name) so the same product always maps to the same ID. Join to dim_product in the silver layer.

columns.name: product_name
columns.description: Full product name including brand, variant and size. Sourced from the product catalogue (2,045 SKUs). Examples: 'Milka Milk Chocolate Bar 100g', 'EKP-Bio Broccoli 500g', 'Barilla Spaghetti Organic 500g'.

columns.name: product_category
columns.description: Top-level product category. Food categories dominate due to weighted draw in the generator.

columns.name: product_subcategory
columns.description: Product subcategory within the category. 30 subcategories total across all categories.

columns.name: product_unit
columns.description: Unit of sale for this product. Drives correct quantity interpretation — a customer buying 3 'kg' of apples is different from buying 3 'pack' of biscuits.

columns.name: is_private_label
columns.description: True if the product is an Einkaufpark own-brand (EKP-Classic, EKP-Bio, EKP-Favourites, EKP-take it easy, EKP-Free). Approximately 35% of eligible products. Private label is priced 10–20% below comparable branded products.

columns.name: brand
columns.description: Brand name. One of the EKP private label names if is_private_label is true, otherwise a national brand name.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Number of units purchased. Known DQ issues: ~1.5% are zero (voided scan, WARN:QTY_ZERO); ~1% are negative (return line, WARN:QTY_NEGATIVE); rare null (ERR:QTY_NULL).

columns.name: unit_price_eur
columns.description: Price per unit in EUR at time of sale. Known DQ issues: ~1% null due to POS lookup failure (ERR:PRICE_NULL); ~0.5% negative as refund adjustment (WARN:PRICE_NEGATIVE). Promo weeks apply an 0.85–0.90x discount to the base range.

columns.name: discount_pct
columns.description: Percentage discount applied to this line item. 80% of rows are 0.0. Range for valid discounts: 0–50%. Known DQ issues: ~1.5% null; ~0.5% exceed 100 due to legacy POS rounding bug (WARN:DISCOUNT_OVER_100).

columns.name: transaction_currency
columns.description: Currency of the transaction. Always EUR for this dataset.

columns.name: net_revenue_eur
columns.description: Computed revenue for this line item: unit_price_eur * quantity * (1 - discount_pct / 100). Null whenever unit_price_eur, quantity, or discount_pct is null or invalid (ERR:REVENUE_NULL). This is the primary revenue metric.

columns.name: payment_type
columns.description: Payment method used for this basket. Distribution: Card 48%, Cash 28%, Apple_Pay 9%, Google_Pay 7%, Voucher 5%, Gift_Card 3%.

columns.name: pos_terminal_id
columns.description: Identifier of the POS terminal that processed the transaction. Format: POS-{store_id}-T{lane number zero-padded}. Terminal count by size class: L=20, M=12, S=6.

columns.name: terminal_type
columns.description: Type of terminal that processed the transaction. Joined from terminal_master.json in the bronze layer using pos_terminal_id. Approximately 30% SCO for L-class stores, 20% for S-class.

columns.name: is_self_checkout
columns.description: True when terminal_type is SELF_CHECKOUT. Derived boolean for convenience — directly answers the business question of whether this was a self-service transaction.

columns.name: cashier_id
columns.description: Employee ID of the cashier who processed the transaction. Format: EMP{4-digit number}. Null when is_self_checkout is true — no staff member is assigned to SCO lanes.

columns.name: promo_week_id
columns.description: ISO week identifier for the transaction date. Format: PW{YYYY-WW}. Used to group transactions by promotional calendar week.

columns.name: is_promo_period
columns.description: True if the transaction falls within a known high-traffic promotional period: Black Friday week (ISO week 47), pre-Easter (ISO weeks 13–15), or Christmas run-up (December 1–23). Promo periods receive approximately 1.4x traffic uplift in the generator.

columns.name: data_quality_flag
columns.description: Pipe-separated string of data quality codes. Value is OK for clean rows. ERR codes trigger quarantine routing in bronze. WARN codes pass through with is_clean=false. INFO codes are informational. Full set: ERR:PRICE_NULL, ERR:QTY_NULL, ERR:REVENUE_NULL, WARN:PRICE_NEGATIVE, WARN:QTY_ZERO, WARN:QTY_NEGATIVE, WARN:AGE_INVALID, WARN:DISCOUNT_OVER_100, WARN:DATE_SEQUENCE_ERROR, INFO:DUPLICATE_TXN.
